children: Activity in Sweden's manufacturing sector increased in October, with the Purchasing Managers' Index rising to 60.5 points from 58.5 points in September, compilers Silf and Swedbank said on Monday.
The index was at its highest since January 2022 and the index has now been over the historical average of 54.4 for six months
The rise in the index was driven by increases in the sub-indices for production, employment and inventory purchases
The sub-indices for orders and delivery times decreased from high levels, Silf/Swedbank said

"Higher cost pressures are a challenge to industry's margins and increases the risk that cost increases are passed on to the producer and consumer sectors. This is something the Riksbank needs to factor in ahead of its next monetary policy decision," Swedbank economist Jorgen Kennemar said
